fusions.name: Hit and Hop
fusions.desc: A headlong butt that deals 14 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and knocks it back 3 tiles. For 3 seconds after using it, you move 25% faster.

fusions.name: Scree Scatter
fusions.desc: Kicks up scree around you, dealing 4 earth damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 25% chance each to leave them [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Surefoot
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds, with +10% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Dig In
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per stack (15% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
